record.final_answer:
The September 2026 total is **5437.50**.

The first run failed with `cannot create out/total-2026-09.txt: Directory nonexistent`. The script writes its result into `out/`, but that folder is excluded from git, so this checkout didn't have it. I created the folder with `mkdir -p out` and reran the script, which worked and also saved the total to `out/total-2026-09.txt`. I didn't touch the script itself.

I also saved a note in memcue (the long-term memory) so a later session in a fresh checkout knows to create `out/` first.
